description: Days to wait before the single reminder on an unanswered request
Days after the original request before the case is closed as withdrawn
Business days (Monday to Friday) after a follow-up request - a clarification, or a request for a document an analyst added after review - before one reminder about it, if the customer still owes it
Optional early nudge: days after a request is sent, if the customer has not viewed it, before one short nudge; 0 = off (the default)
